images.prompt: Original production concept sheet for the real-time strategy game Stahlfront: five resource deposits in one row on a plain charcoal studio ground, each shown from the same orthographic three-quarter game camera, uncropped with clear margins. From left: a stacked timber yard with neat pyramids of peeled spruce logs, pale cut faces and sawdust; an iron ore outcrop of dark basalt boulders with rust-orange mineral veins, a small ore cart and loose lumps; a crude oil well with a nodding pumpjack, a tar pool with a faint rainbow sheen, a pipe manifold and stacked steel barrels; a gold vein in pale quartzite with bright metallic gold seams and a few rough nuggets in a wooden crate; a supply depot of weathered wooden crates and canvas-strapped pallets on a concrete pad. Grounded photoreal materials, believable construction, finely weathered, modern game art. No lettering, no logos, no people, no flags, no explosions.
